name: The Four Lifts on the Canal du Centre and their Environs, La Louvière and Le Roeulx (Hainaut)
description: Near La Louvière in Belgium's old industrial heartland, four giant hydraulic boat lifts raise and lower barges along a short stretch of the Canal du Centre. Built around the turn of the 20th century, they are the only survivors in their original working condition of eight such lifts once built. Seen alongside the canal and its structures, they form a remarkably intact industrial landscape.
